subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Vehicle physics support subsystem: wheel-contact height-field maintenance over a fixed-stride element array, car physics state allocation and vehicle-entry dispatch, zero-guarded wheel-speed conversion, the all-active-vehicles session predicate, global physics initialization, and the shared vector/matrix/quaternion transform math library the physics frame path builds upon (scalar, SSE and 3DNow variants).

summary: Conservative architecture proposal for 28 validated vehicle-physics functions. 0x004046B0 and 0x00404790 form a DERIVED wheel-contact height-field pair over the same owner: element count at this+0x130, element array at this+0x134 with a 316-byte stride, and a node-type threshold at this+0x10; both are invoked by 0x00404250. 0x004B9780/0x004B9810/0x004B9D80 form a GUESS allocator/dispatch group over a pointer member at this+0x0 (3996-byte car physics state allocation via 0x00587C03 + 0x004B57F0, then load-entries and list-count dispatch). 0x004D24A0 is a session predicate over the dword_7C54F0 active-vehicle array bounded by dword_5C329C. The remaining functions are pure math helpers with no evidenced owning object: a 17-function transform library (interface VectorMatrixTransformMath) writing a shared 4-float output layout at +0x0/+0x4/+0x8/+0xC, and a GUESS quaternion-composition group (0x0050E342 blend, 0x0051FEBE component packing, 0x005267A7 multi-input composition with jump table 0x0052690F). Owners are packet-UNKNOWN except 0x005267A7 (DERIVED). Several prelabel cluster-copy twin assignments (0x0051ECEE/FloatClamp, 0x00526CA8/sub_410AF0, 0x00526D36/FloatClamp) conflict with the raw math and are not adopted.

function_roles.role: Per-node wheel-contact height reconstruction/smoothing over the stride-316 element array (count this+0x130, base this+0x134): below the node-type threshold this+0x10 the +76 contact height is zeroed and rebuilt by walking the +272/+268 ancestor chain accumulating (*(node+268)+76) + (*(node+268)+60); at/above the threshold the height is averaged against a spatial neighbor found via SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest (0x004038E0).
Iterates the same stride-316 element array (count this+0x130, base this+0x134) and calls the unregistered helper 0x004FB5D0 with each element pointer; returns the element count.
Thin wrapper that forwards the address of the global double dbl_7C7428 to a downstream physics-init routine and returns its result unchanged; the global is addressed but not dereferenced here.

Zero-guarded conversion of two speed inputs (a2, a3) into wheel-speed units (integer formula 1000*x/8), stored into target offsets +0x50 and +0x54 of the object resolved through this+0x0; each store happens only when the promoted input is greater than 0.0.

Allocates a 3996-byte block via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03); on success initializes it with CarPhysicsStateInitializer (0x004B57F0) and stores the returned pointer at this+0x0, otherwise stores 0 at this+0x0; returns this.
Single-function dispatch wrapper: dereferences this+0x0 and passes the loaded pointer to LoadVehicleEntries, returning the callee result unchanged; no null guard.
Single-function dispatch wrapper: dereferences this+0x0 and passes the loaded pointer to VehicleListCountGetter, returning the callee result unchanged; no null guard.

Session predicate over active vehicles: returns true when dword_5C329C is non-positive, or when every one of the first dword_5C329C pointers in the dword_7C54F0 array points to a vehicle whose dword at +0x4064 is nonzero; returns false as soon as one active vehicle's +0x4064 dword is zero.
Column-major 4x4 affine transform of a 3-component input vector (translation in matrix column 3, a3[12..15]) into a 4-component output; branchless, returns the output pointer.
Row-major 4x4 matrix times 4-component vector transform; each output component is one matrix row dotted with the input vector; returns the output pointer.

Weighted blend of two transforms: total weight v10 = a5 + a6; when FloatRangeCheck (0x0050C042) reports it near zero the source a2 is copied to a1 verbatim, otherwise two intermediates are built via ThunkToFUN0050e174 (0x0050E198) and blended with normalized weight a6/v10.
2D-affine 4x4 transform: 2-component input (a2[0], a2[1]) treated as [x, y, 0, 1] row-vector times matrix a3, producing a 4-component output; matrix column 2 and input z are unused.
2D-point transform by 4x4 matrix into the homogeneous triple (X, Y, w); perspective-divides X/Y by w when FloatRangeCheck (0x0050C042) reports w is not approximately 1.0.
3D-point transform by 4x4 matrix into (X, Y, Z, w); perspective-divides X/Y/Z by w when FloatRangeCheck (0x0050C042) reports w is not approximately 1.0.
2-component vector transform by a row-major 4x4 matrix (translation column a3[12..15]) into a 4-component output; branch-free, returns the output pointer.
3-component point transform by a 4x4 matrix (translation embedded in a3[12..15], implicit homogeneous 1); writes all four output components and returns the output pointer.
3-component vector transform where each output component is the dot product of the input with one stride-4 matrix column; writes a 3-component output.
4-component vector times row-major 4x4 matrix transform; each output component is one matrix row dotted with the full input vector.
SSE 4x4-matrix by 3-component-vector transform; matrix pointer alignment (a3 & 0xF) selects aligned (columns +0/+16/+32/+48) vs unaligned (columns +8/+24/+40/+56) column loads.

Packs three unsigned component inputs plus constant dword_8D6160 into an SSE vector, applies the channel mask xmmword_8D6150, passes it through RGBAColorSpaceConversion (0x005289E0), then applies a shuffle/multiply/add/xor sequence with sign mask xmmword_8D6140 and writes the __m128 result to the output.
SSE 3-component vector transform through a 3x4 matrix (x*row0 + y*row1 + z*row2); matrix alignment dispatches between unaligned 8-byte half-row loads and aligned __m128 row loads.
SSE 3-component vector transform by a matrix with an unweighted translation row, then divides all components by the w lane using an SSE reciprocal refined by one Newton-Raphson iteration.

3DNow lookup-based scaled transform: queries a 12-byte precomputed entry through 0x005262C2 by selector a2, scales input a3 by 0.5, expands lanes via PackedFloatingPointMath (0x005295E0), and writes the packed __m64 output pair.

3DNow two-stage vector normalization composition: normalizes a3 and a4 relative to base vector a2 with factor (a5+a6), then normalizes the first result relative to the second with scale a6/(a5+a6) using a refined reciprocal; outputs via SIMDVectorNormalization (0x005215DB).

3DNow 4D vector transform: pairs the 4-component input words, accumulates SIMD products against coefficient table a3[0..7], divides through the w component with a refined 3DNow reciprocal, and writes a full __m64 product plus a truncated 32-bit value.

Composes a 3D transform from up to three inputs selected by the null-state of a6/a7/a8 (jump table global 0x0052690F), applies the transform to a4 writing a3 via F_4DVectorTransform (0x00526550), then optionally applies an MMX packed-float weight blend from a5 using constants 0x005AF980/0x005AF988/0x005AF990.

3DNow 2-component vector transform: duplicates the two input lanes and forms two linear combinations against the 8-slot coefficient matrix a3 (a1[0] = a3[0]*x + a3[2]*y + a3[6], a1[1] = a3[1]*x + a3[3]*y + a3[7]).

3DNow perspective-style 2-component transform: forms two linear combinations over the packed pairs at a3[0..3]/a3[6..7], uses the second combination's high lane as a reciprocal-approximated divisor, and stores the scaled first combination into the output.

classes.name: WheelContactHeightField
classes.responsibility: Owns the stride-316 wheel-contact element array (count this+0x130, base this+0x134) and the node-type threshold this+0x10; reconstructs per-node contact heights through ancestor chains below the threshold and smooths them via spatial-neighbor averaging at/above it.

classes.name: CarPhysicsStateAllocator
classes.responsibility: Owns a pointer member at this+0x0 holding a car physics / vehicle-entry state object; allocates and initializes it as a 3996-byte block, then dispatches vehicle-entry loading and vehicle-list count queries through it.

classes.name: SessionEndConditionCheck
classes.responsibility: Evaluates the all-active-vehicles-satisfy-flag predicate over the global active-vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 bounded by dword_5C329C; a vehicle's dword at +0x4064 must be nonzero for a true result.

classes.name: WheelSpeedSetter
classes.responsibility: Holds a target-object pointer at this+0x0 and converts two speed inputs to wheel-speed units (1000*x/8) under positive-input guards, storing the results at target offsets +0x50/+0x54.

classes.name: PhysicsStateInitializer
classes.responsibility: Initializes global physics state by forwarding the address of the dbl_7C7428 global to a downstream physics-init routine whose target is outside this packet.

classes.name: QuaternionTransformComposition
classes.responsibility: Builds, blends and composes quaternion-style 4-component transform representations: weighted SLERP-like blend (0x0050E342), component packing through color-space conversion (0x0051FEBE), and multi-input composition with an optional packed-float weight blend (0x005267A7).

classes.name: Vec4TransformOutput
classes.responsibility: The 16-byte, 4-float output-vector buffer written by the transform helpers (components at +0x0/+0x4/+0x8/+0xC); an ephemeral write destination, not a long-lived owning object.

transitions.trigger: element node type (element + 300) reaches/equals the threshold this+0x10 -> contact height smoothed by averaging with the spatial-neighbor result
element node type (element + 300) drops below the threshold this+0x10 -> contact height zeroed and rebuilt from the +272/+268 ancestor chain
matrix pointer (a3 & 0xF) nonzero -> unaligned 8-byte half-row / shifted-column loads selected
matrix pointer 16-byte aligned (a3 & 0xF) == 0 -> aligned __m128 row/column loads selected

interfaces.name: VectorMatrixTransformMath
interfaces.purpose: Pure coordinate-transform math library: affine and homogeneous transforms of 2/3/4-component vectors and points by 4x4 or 3x4 matrices, scalar and SIMD (SSE, 3DNow), with optional perspective division. Functions act on raw pointers (a1 output vector, a2 input vector, a3 matrix) and share the 4-float output layout at +0x0/+0x4/+0x8/+0xC; no persistent owning object is evidenced.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelContactElementArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The wheel-contact element array lives at this+0x134 with element count at this+0x130 and a fixed 316-byte stride. A replacement must preserve the stride, the node-type threshold at this+0x10, the contact-height rebuild/smoothing behavior of 0x004046B0 (ancestor-chain accumulation below the threshold, spatial-neighbor averaging at/above it via the spatial query 0x004038E0), and the per-element pass of the unregistered helper 0x004FB5D0 by 0x00404790.

compatibility_contracts.name: CarPhysicsStateAllocation
compatibility_contracts.description: Car physics state is allocated as a 3996-byte block through the operator-new wrapper 0x00587C03, initialized by CarPhysicsStateInitializer 0x004B57F0, and the resulting pointer stored at this+0x0 (null stored on allocation failure). A replacement must reproduce the allocation size, the init path, and the null-on-failure behavior of 0x004B9780, and must keep the this+0x0 pointer loadable for the vehicle-entry dispatch wrappers 0x004B9810/0x004B9D80.

compatibility_contracts.name: ActiveVehicleFlagPredicate
compatibility_contracts.description: Session end-condition evaluation calls 0x004D24A0, which reads the active-vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 bounded by the count dword_5C329C and requires every active vehicle's dword at +0x4064 to be nonzero for a true result. A replacement must preserve this predicate and the two globals it consumes.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelSpeedUnitConversion
compatibility_contracts.description: Wheel speeds are converted with the integer formula 1000*x/8 under a positive-input guard and stored at target offsets +0x50/+0x54 of the object resolved through this+0x0. A replacement must reproduce the conversion, the guard (non-positive inputs skip their store), and the two target offsets.

compatibility_contracts.name: TransformOutputVectorLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Vector/matrix transform helpers write a 4-float output at +0x0/+0x4/+0x8/+0xC and return the output pointer; perspective helpers (0x0050E7CB, 0x0050E927, 0x0052004E, 0x00526D36) divide the transformed components by homogeneous w when w is not approximately 1.0 (tolerance supplied by FloatRangeCheck 0x0050C042). A replacement must preserve this output layout and the divide condition.

compatibility_contracts.name: QuaternionCompositionDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x005267A7 selects among up to three transform sources by the null-state combination of three inputs via the jump table at global 0x0052690F (8 cases including identity, passthrough and pairwise/all-three composition through 0x005265DB), applies the selected transform through F_4DVectorTransform (0x00526550), and optionally blends the output with packed-float weights from a5 using constants 0x005AF980/0x005AF988/0x005AF990. A replacement must preserve the case-to-composition mapping and the transform application order.

unresolved: Element struct layout of the stride-316 wheel-contact array (offsets +60, +76, +268, +272, +276, +300) is only partially understood; the +268 parent/back and +272 next-node pointer roles are inferred from the walk pattern, not proven.
Meaning of the node-type threshold this+0x10 and the node-type enum at element +300 is not established by the packet.
The unregistered helper 0x004FB5D0 is undocumented (FAILNODOCENTRY); its per-element effect is unknown.
The helper 0x004038E0 (SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest) is outside this packet and its query semantics are not detailed here.

LoadVehicleEntries and VehicleListCountGetter are named only in the decompiled source text; their target addresses are absent from the packet callee list, so those two calls are evidenced by source text alone.
The physics-init callee of 0x00435280 is absent from the packet callee list; the call target cannot be confirmed, and the type/role of the global double dbl_7C7428 is unestablished.
Global flt_59E440 (0x0059E440) does not appear in the raw source of 0x00465160; its role as the zero-threshold constant is DERIVED from prior analysis, not confirmed.
Global flt_59E450 (0x0059E450) is listed in the packet globals but is not referenced in the raw source of 0x004046B0; its role is unresolved.
The +0x4064 per-vehicle dword read by 0x004D24A0 is unnamed here; a nonzero value likely flags a completed/retired state but that is not evidenced.
dword_5C329C is treated as the count of active slots because it bounds the dword_7C54F0 scan; its exact semantics are inferred, not named.

CarPhysicsStateAllocator is a GUESS grouping: 0x004B9780, 0x004B9810 and 0x004B9D80 share the this+0x0 pointer-member pattern but their callers are not fully proven common, and the 3996-byte object type is unconfirmed.
Whether CarPhysicsStateInitializer (0x004B57F0) returns its argument or a different pointer is not evidenced.
Caller 0x00463F70 (SessionTypeSetter) mentioned in the 0x00465160 summary is not in the allowed evidence set and was not used as a fact.
Row-major vs column-major matrix orientation is not provable for several transform helpers; the stride-4 layout with translation in m[12..15] is certain, the orientation is not.

QuaternionTransformComposition is a GUESS grouping inferred from ABI-lead naming (Quaternion_SLERP, QuaternionConstructionTransform); 0x0051FEBE's use of RGBAColorSpaceConversion (0x005289E0) and color channel/sign masks is unexplained for a quaternion role.

The 0x005267A7 packed-float blend formula (which a3 components are weighted and how a5 integers map to an interpolation factor) is opaque in the MMX/3DNow intrinsics; which constant each of 0x005AF980/0x005AF988/0x005AF990 holds is not confirmed.
Composition ordering semantics for the all-three-present case (case 7) of 0x005267A7 are unverified.
Global qword_5AF990 appears in the deterministic facts of 0x0052156F but is absent from its raw source; the 12-byte lookup entry layout produced by 0x005262C2 is undocumented.
The 0x00526550 a1[1] 32-bit truncation suggests a fixed-point or screen-space result, but the interpretation is unconfirmed.

The prelabel cluster-copy twin assignments for 0x0051ECEE (FloatClamp 0x004646C0), 0x00526CA8 (sub_410AF0) and 0x00526D36 (FloatClamp 0x004646C0) conflict with the raw transform math and were not adopted.
No caller evidence links the transform helpers to a specific owning class; owners stay UnknownObject/UNKNOWN and the VectorMatrixTransformMath interface is a synthesis.
